[!cgo] skip
[!GOARCH:amd64] [!GOARCH:arm64] skip

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=1

env GOEXPERIMENT=logosfastcgo
go build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42$'

go tool objdump -s 'runtime\.logosCgocallFast' app$GOEXE
stdout 'reentersyscall'
stdout 'asmcgocall'
stdout 'exitsyscall'
! stdout 'nanotime'
! stdout 'cputicks'
! stdout 'clock_gettime'
! stdout 'monotonic'

logos build -o logosapp$GOEXE .
exec ./logosapp$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42$'

go tool objdump -s 'runtime\.logosCgocallFast' logosapp$GOEXE
stdout 'reentersyscall'
stdout 'asmcgocall'
stdout 'exitsyscall'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/fastcallseq

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

/*
#cgo noescape add
#cgo nocallback add
int add(int a, int b) {
	return a + b;
}
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Printf("sum%d\n", int(C.add(40, 2)))
}
